terminology_decisions: GameHQ, GameInput, XInput, DualSense, SHA-256, HTTPS, executable names, paths, switches, URLs, and placeholders remain protected.
A saved capture is „materiał”; the act of capture uses „przechwytywanie” or the concrete screenshot/clip noun.
Replay is „powtórka”; replay buffer is „bufor powtórek” or „bufor cykliczny” according to available space and function.
Input binding is „przypisanie”, while input as a control concept is „sterowanie”.
Overlay is consistently „nakładka”, and active-window focus is expressed as bringing GameHQ to the foreground.
Slot is „miejsce” in storage/user-facing contexts rather than the borrowed word „slot”.
Update, signed package, verification, recovery, and rollback wording remains technically distinct and unambiguous.
Sidebar labels remain compact: „Info” and „Wesprzyj GameHQ”; the Ko-fi URL is invariant.
calibration_rules: Review every stable ID with its English source, source location, control role, and neighboring UI; schema validity is not linguistic evidence.
Prefer established Polish product terminology over literal English syntax, but preserve protected technical names.
Use concise noun labels for navigation and buttons, complete sentences for explanations, and direct imperative forms for actions.
Treat destructive, recovery, update, privacy, and security strings as safety-critical terminology decisions.
Validate Polish plural forms and placeholder-inflected grammar in context, not only placeholder counts.
Record every changed translation as an auditable before/after delta and leave no unresolved issue hidden by fallback.
